shortDescription: Adobe NASDAQ:ADBE will work with Walt Disney NYSE:DIS to develop artificial intelligence applications for the entertainment company's creative and content development operations under a new multi-year agreement announced on Monday.Under the agreement, Adobe NASDAQ:ADBE will provide Disney NYSE:DIS…

children: to develop artificial intelligence applications for the entertainment company's creative and content development operations under a new multi-year agreement announced on Monday.
with early access to its AI and creative technologies, including Firefly, Firefly Foundry, Premiere, and Photoshop, alongside dedicated engineering and research resources.
A key component of the partnership is the development of customized generative AI models based on Disney’s

intellectual property. The models will be designed to generate commercially safe, production-ready content using Disney-specific character attributes, environments, and visual styles, the companies said.

Walt Disney Imagineering Research & Development is already using Firefly Foundry to accelerate concept development for theme parks. Applications include converting hand-drawn sketches into rendered concept art and generating creative assets aligned with Disney
The alliance also extends to Disney’s
StudioLAB and ESPN Edge innovation centers. The companies plan to explore AI applications in creative workflows, sports content, and the use of ESPN’s archive.
Beyond technology development, the agreement includes global marketing initiatives, industry events, and customer storytelling. Adobe
will expand its presence across Disney’s
media platforms, while joint projects with StudioLAB and ESPN Edge are already underway.
The companies said the collaboration builds on their longstanding relationship and will focus on integrating emerging technologies while protecting creators and their work.

title: Disney steps up generative AI push with expanded Adobe collaboration
